options.name: agent_version
options.description: Optional: Set config override for a specific agent version. If not set the config override will apply on all agent versions

options.name: config_override
options.description: The config override data Required when I(state=present) or I(state=absent) Will be ignored if I(state=prune)

options.name: description
options.description: Optional: Set a description for the config override Will be ignored if I(state=absent) or I(state=prune)

options.name: group
options.description: Enter group name here If this option is set the scope is set to group level. Otherwise scope is set to site level

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the config override Will be ignored if I(state=absent) or I(state=prune) Required if I(state=present)

options.name: os_type
options.description: The os type for which the config is set

options.name: site_name
options.description: Name of the site in SentinelOne

options.name: state
options.description: C(present): Make sure the config override exists. If no override object for the selected scope exists it will be created. If an override object already exists the new config will get merged into the existing one. C(absent): Absent will only remove the settings from the override object you specify by C(config_override) parameter. If the C(config_override) parameter conatins all existing settings the whole object will be deleted instead In this mode only the keys of C(config_override) will be used

options.name: token
options.description: SentinelOne API auth token to authenticate at the management API
